placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for submission intake, identity derivation, and commit mechanics.
placements.title: Ingestion and persistence architecture for submitted artifacts
placements.frame: How are submitted artifacts processed, identified, and persisted through the ingestion pipeline?

placements.title: Deriving identity from content ensures uninterrupted persistence when explicit IDs are omitted
placements.frame: How does the pipeline guarantee reliable persistence when a submission lacks an explicit identifier?
placements.why: Captures the architectural policy that missing explicit IDs trigger content-based slug generation (LLM id-gen with deterministic slugify fallback) to complete file commits without failure.
